name: Reviver: Orange
source:
Reviver is a Brazilian visual novel, available only in Portuguese.

The story takes place in the year 2020, in a fictional city called Hokkai, Japan.
The protagonist is an otaku who will begin his first year of college in an arts course after a frustrating and tedious childhood and pre-adolescence.
Little did he know that his life would change from there, having to make complex and difficult decisions that will secure his future with several new characters introduced into his life. The bully of the school, the strange and quiet girl, the tsundere, the popular one, the class leader among others.
translation:
Reviver是一部巴西视觉小说，仅提供葡萄牙语版本。

故事发生在2020年，一个虚构的日本北海城市。
主角是一名御宅族，在经历了令人沮丧和乏味的童年和青春期前之后，他将开始大学第一年的艺术课程。
他几乎不知道他的生活将从那里开始改变，他必须做出复杂而艰难的决定，以确保他的未来，并引入几个新角色。校霸、古灵精怪的安静女孩、傲娇、人气、班长等等。
